notes: Every number and quoted passage of the reliability record page (site/reliability/record/record.md), with the record that holds it. r1_ is the first reliable job (replacement-01: bowl on the cabinet top and middle drawer open, no order rule); b_ and b2_ are story B, unchanged from the 20 October record. r2_ is the second reliable job (plate-cabinet-01: plate at the stove front and bowl on the cabinet top, no order rule). Bind with: python -m fleetlab.film.record bind site/reliability/record/record.md --fields site/reliability/record/fields.json --records site/reliability/record/records-final-2-2026-10-20.json --out DIR --final.

records.r1_run: the first job's investigation record: <investigation>/job_run.json (request, agent, sessions, costs, message_log, account, library_mounted)
records.r1_receipt: the first job's release receipt: <investigation>/release/run/run/receipt.json (N, K, delivered, naive_delivered, rescued, broken, pairs, release_starts, starts_fresh)
records.r1_verification: the coordinator's reconciliation of the 40 raw release episodes: <cohort>/coordinator-verification.json
records.r1_development: the development tables the agent queried, sessions 1 to 4: <investigation>/runs/session-0N/run/log/job_episodes.parquet (job ids unique across them)
records.r1_session_two: the agent's second session as its transcript records it: <investigation>/agent-runs/<session 2>/stdout.jsonl (its messages and tool calls)
records.r1_job: the saved job as the library holds it: <investigation>/library/jobs/station-bowl-and-open-drawer.json
records.r1_library: the library's index after the investigation: <investigation>/library/index.json
records.r1_inherited_job: the earlier saved job in the library the agent started from: job one's run-6 library, jobs/cheese-loaded-bowl-to-cabinet.json (saved, not released; its own receipt unchanged)
records.r1_rerenders: the verification reports of the four re-renders of reserved start 31 (scene and wrist, plain chain and saved job); the wrist reports are the corrected ones naming the wrist original
records.r1_recordings: the four re-rendered recordings those reports verify
records.story_b_operation: story B's regular work before round one: <engagement>/loop/rounds/r1/exports/start-01/log/episodes.parquet
records.story_b_engagement: story B's engagement record: <engagement>/engagement/engagement.json (rounds, decisions, evaluation.summary)
records.story_b_recipe_check: the probe recipe run on the later fleet: second-use/check-2/recipe-check.json
records.r2_run: the second job's investigation record: <second investigation>/job_run.json
records.r2_verification: the coordinator's reconciliation of the second job's 40 raw release episodes: <second cohort>/coordinator-verification.json
records.r2_development: the second job's development tables the agent queried, sessions 1 to 6: <second investigation>/runs/session-0N/run/log/job_episodes.parquet
records.r2_library: the library's index after the second investigation: <second investigation>/library/index.json (three saved jobs: the earlier unreleased one and the two released jobs)
records.r2_cheese: the coordinator's read of the cheese's final recorded state in the second job's 20 reserved runs: <second cohort>/relocated-cheese-final-positions.json (from the public object table)
records.r2_rerenders: the verification reports of the four re-renders of the second job's reserved start 31
records.r2_recordings: the four re-rendered recordings those reports verify
records.all_rerenders: both pairs' re-render verification reports, the same files as r1_rerenders and r2_rerenders
records.r2_recount: a recount of two second-job diagnostics, one row per episode: <reliability>/record-recounts/second-job-diagnostics.json, written by site/reliability/record/recount_second_job.py from the confirmation batch's public goal table and the coordinator's cheese record (both listed with their SHA-256 inside)
